svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-03 Engagement and mode management under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 10 cards for F-03 Engagement and mode management, one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B; callout: runs into the stopped car. M02 Stops Functioning: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C; callout: crosses edge line. M03 Unrequested Function: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C; callout: into the next lane. M04 Function Stuck: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B, covered by M01; callout: runs into the stopped car. M06 Partial Function: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B; callout: runs into the stopped car. M08 Functions Late: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B, covered by M11; callout: stops closer to the car. M10 Function Applies Too Long: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B, covered by M01; callout: runs into the stopped car. M11 Function is Delayed: H-05, SG-05 ASIL B; callout: stops closer to the car. M12 Inverse Function: H-01, SG-01 ASIL C, covered by M03; callout: into the next lane. M13 Erratic or Intermittent: H-02, SG-02 ASIL C, covered by M02; callout: drops out again and again.
svg.text: Guide-word scenes · F-03 Engagement and mode management
The 10 safety-relevant (SC) guide words. Chart: the function (engaged state (or the car's response, see
card)), required vs performed. Scene: what it does to the car.
WP-C-03 §4 · hara_model.FM · schematic, not simulation output · phone view
Driver unable to override or disengage
Disengagement on brake, cancel or override does
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
System disengages while the driver relies on it,
Engagement without a driver request (the envelope
gates on the PCM cruise rising edge); unexpected
steering and acceleration. Lateral is the worst
case and is rated here; the acceleration of a false
engagement is rated as F-02 M05 in OS-13
Driver unable to override or disengage
Engagement state stuck at 'engaged'; same as
Driver unable to override or disengage
Partial disengagement: one axis released, the other
still actuating after brake or cancel.
Driver unable to override or disengage
Disengagement after the driver input has passed;
Driver unable to override or disengage
Engagement continues after the driver ends it;
Driver unable to override or disengage
Release delayed beyond the specified time after
Engages when the driver cancels; same as
Unannounced loss or degradation of lateral control
Scenes are drawn to explain each hazard; the plant runs are in assurance/sim §3.7. Ratings are proposals for review
until the I3 confirmation review (WP-C-03 header). Generated by hara_figures.py.
